capture_start_rule: Fixed future UTC boundary selected before collector implementation; never moved based on capture quality or research outcome

local_receive_timestamp_policy.wall_clock: UTC Unix milliseconds captured immediately after frame receipt
local_receive_timestamp_policy.monotonic: time.monotonic_ns captured immediately after frame receipt

sequence_validation_policy.bootstrap: buffer depth; REST snapshot; discard u < lastUpdateId; require first bridge U <= lastUpdateId <= u
sequence_validation_policy.continuity: every subsequent pu must equal previous u
sequence_validation_policy.discontinuity: append GAP audit event then clear book and REST resync
sequence_validation_policy.duplicate: u <= current update id is stale and never double-applied

raw_retention_policy: UTC-daily SQLite WAL partitions; immutable closed-partition SHA-256 manifest; raw files ignored by Git
